problem_statement: The payroll dashboard currently has no way to filter or locate employees quickly. As the employee list grows, scrolling through all records becomes cumbersome. Users need a search box on the main dashboard that filters the employee table in real time as they type, matching against both employee name and job title so HR and managers can find the right person instantly.

user_stories.i_want: a search box on the payroll dashboard
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly locate employees without scrolling through the entire list

user_stories.i_want: the employee list to filter in real time as I type
user_stories.so_that: I get immediate visual feedback and can refine my query interactively

user_stories.i_want: the search to match against both name and job title
user_stories.so_that: I can find employees by either their identity or their role

user_stories.i_want: to see a clear message when no employees match my search
user_stories.so_that: I know the filter is working and my query returned no results

must_have: A text input search box is visible on the main payroll dashboard (the / route)
Typing in the search box filters the visible employee records in real time without a page reload
Filtering matches against employee name (case-insensitive, partial match)
Filtering matches against employee job title (case-insensitive, partial match)
Employees that do not match the current search query are hidden from view
An empty search query shows all employees (restores the full list)
When no employees match the search query, a visible empty-state message is displayed
should_have: The search input is clearly labeled or has a descriptive placeholder (e.g., 'Search by name or title…')
Filtering is performed client-side via JavaScript to avoid full page reloads
The search box is visually consistent with the existing dashboard styling in src/public/styles.css
The search state is not persisted across page reloads (ephemeral filter)
nice_to_have: A clear/reset button or × icon inside the search box to quickly clear the query
Highlighting of matching text within the filtered results
Debouncing of the input event to avoid excessive DOM operations on fast typing

acceptance_criteria: Verify a search input element is rendered on the main dashboard page (GET /)
Verify that typing a string matching an employee's name shows only that employee's card/row
Verify that typing a string matching a job title shows only employees with that title
Verify that the search is case-insensitive (e.g., 'CEO' matches 'Chief Executive Officer' via partial match)
Verify that clearing the search input restores the full employee list
Verify that typing a query with no matches hides all employee records and shows an empty-state message
Verify that no page reload or server round-trip occurs when the user types in the search box
Verify that the search box has a descriptive placeholder or label
out_of_scope: Server-side search via query parameters or a new API endpoint
Persisting the search query in the URL or localStorage across sessions
Filtering by fields other than name and title (e.g., salary range, manager, address)
Sorting or ordering the filtered results
Advanced search syntax such as boolean operators or quoted phrases
Authentication or authorization gating for the search feature
Search across pages other than the main payroll dashboard
open_questions: Should the search filter apply to both the employee table view and the expandable employee cards, or only one of them? The dashboard currently renders employees in both a summary table and detail cards.
Should the empty-state message replace the table/card area entirely, or appear inline below the search box?
Is there a preferred placement for the search box on the page (e.g., above the employee table, inside the header, or in a dedicated toolbar section)?
Should the search box be autofocused when the page loads, or only focused on explicit user click/tab?
